title: India's Funniest People Are Headed to Netflix! An Exciting Comedy Lineup Awaits You This Season
summary: From blockbuster comedies and stand-up specials to unscripted chaos and fan-favourite shows, Netflix is celebrating ‘Har Type Ka Funny’ (comedy in every form) this season.
body_markdown:
Entertainment


08 September 2026


Global


India


Link copied to clipboard


From blockbuster comedies and stand-up specials to unscripted chaos and fan-favourite shows, Netflix is celebrating ‘Har Type Ka Funny’ (comedy in every form) this season. When it comes to laughter, nobody does it quite like Netflix!


This season, Netflix is serving up laughs in more ways than one, bringing together some of the most loved names on the Indian comedy scene.


Comedy has a way of finding its audience.


The best comedy doesn't just make you laugh in the moment — it gives people something to share, quote, recreate and talk about long after the credits roll, and Netflix's expanding slate reflects just how many different shapes that laughter can take.


Whatever your sense of humour,


Netflix has ‘


Har Type Ka Funny’


covered.


The comedy celebration season kicks off with the mega adventure-comedy franchise film


Dhamaal 4,


followed by quirky family entertainer


Chumbak


, from the makers of


Khichdi


and


Sarabhai vs Sarabhai


, Zakir Khan's endearing stand-up special


[Papa Yaar](https://www.netflix.com/title/82924249) brings a heartfelt comedic look at the unspoken, complex dynamics between Indian fathers and their sons, while


The Great Indian Kapil Show


returns for


Season 5


with another round of the country's family-favourite mix of warmth, chaos and laughter. We're also welcoming fresh voices alongside returning favorites: Bhuvan Bam’s


Dhindora


is back for a second season, and comedian


Sumukhi Suresh


joins Netflix,


bringing their unique voices and humour to audiences soon. Rounding out the lineup, more of Samay Raina’s


India’s Got Latent


is on the way, including its recently released Netflix-exclusive episode featuring Varun Dhawan.


Monika Shergill, Vice President, Content, Netflix India shares,


“The only thing better than watching together is laughing together. That's the spirit behind our comedy slate - we've brought the most exciting entertainers, voices and stories across films, series and stand-up specials to make sure there's a laugh for everyone. We can't wait for families, friends and fans to come together and celebrate the joy of laughing together on Netflix.”


And the laughs don’t stop with this season’s new releases.


Netflix’s expansive library offers audiences an ever-growing mix of Indian and global comedy titles.


From homegrown stories and beloved Indian comedians to acclaimed international comedy hits, there’s a wealth of titles to discover, revisit and enjoy with something to make everyone laugh.


That is the magic of comedy on Netflix: it can be deeply personal and completely communal at the same time, with something in it to suit everyone’s style of humour. The mix will showcase established favourites, distinctive comic voices and stories that speak to audiences across generations.


Netflix is creating space for comedy to surprise, connect and become part of the culture.


When it comes to comedy, there isn't one way to laugh. There isn't one audience. And there certainly isn't just one show or film.


There's just Netflix.
